_comment: Engine modes + battery deploy (POLISH card). modes: each scales engine power and fuel burn (save trades pace for fuel, push the reverse). battery: charges from braking only (harvestShare of the braking power), never from the engine; holding deploy with throttle adds deployKW of power while there's charge, at most maxDeployPerLapKJ per lap (resets at the line). startPct = charge at the start of a session. Keys: E cycles the mode, hold Shift (either) or / to deploy.
